[public_editorial_quality.material_claim_evidence_missing] The linked fact supports strong LATAM finance-app growth but does not establish the claimed differing regional session-length patterns on which this interpretation also relies.

[public_editorial_quality.material_claim_evidence_missing] The item's binding establishes only LATAM finance-app install growth of 76% and session growth of 57%; it does not establish the additional global and regional session-length values and comparisons asserted.

[public_editorial_quality.material_claim_evidence_missing] Although framed as advice, this directs readers to distinguish outcomes from a 2030 projection that the item's download-only binding does not establish.

[public_editorial_quality.material_claim_evidence_missing] The linked download fact does not establish that the report pairs the reported activity and spending with a longer-term projection; those additional report-content assertions lack an item-level source binding.

[public_editorial_quality.material_claim_evidence_missing] The item's binding supports the download figure only; it does not establish the consumer-spending increase or the separate 2030 global-GDP projection also asserted in this text.

[public_editorial_quality.distinctness_redundant_primary_analysis] The public content covers the planned findings and adds useful category-specific implications and recommendations. However, the primary-analysis CPI insight's so-what sentence merely restates that deal discovery CPI moved opposite to the all-e-commerce figure, already stated in its primary finding, without a new analytical contribution. Dimensions: distinctness: The e-commerce CPI so-what repeats the primary finding's opposite-direction comparison rather than adding a distinct interpretation or useful implication.
